verifiedProduct.problem: listEvidence read independent agent-summary.json files serially.
verifiedProduct.change: Read all evidence summaries through a bounded 32-worker async pool; preserve full result set, malformed/incomplete skip behavior, and chronological sort.
verifiedProduct.antiRegression: No caps, pagination shortcut, cache, data/evidence reduction, target reduction, or weaker validation.

benchmark.method: same complete filesystem workload; five repeated scans

challenge.method: paired nine-run alternating-order serial vs 8/16/32/64 readers
challenge.finding: Every bounded setting materially beat serial; no stable winner among 8-64 across 500/2000/5000 dirs, so 32 stayed to avoid tuning churn.

verifiedProduct.regression: 96 valid finalized dirs plus malformed/incomplete dirs; exactly all 96 valid runs returned uniquely in descending time order.

ecosystemRotation: CI orchestration/sharding; cache correctness/invalidation; deterministic replay; evidence indexing/correlation; result interoperability

maximumImprovementChallenge.concurrencyTuning: 8/16/32/64 sweeps all beat serial but no stable winner; no arbitrary retune.
maximumImprovementChallenge.dependencyCache: Not adopted: no package-lock.json and recent install cost is only a few seconds; weak caching risks stale state.
maximumImprovementChallenge.orchestratorReplacement: Nx/Turbo/Dagger/moon/Bazel not adopted wholesale without same-workload proof.
